list.name: sysconfig changes
list.rawSql: SELECT ts as time, note as text, key as tags FROM nyquist_live.sysconfig_changes WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts, (1 - maxIf(p99,name='cpu_usage_idle') / nullIf(maxIf(p99,name='cpu_usage_idle') + maxIf(p99,name='cpu_usage_user') + maxIf(p99,name='cpu_usage_system') + maxIf(p99,name='cpu_usage_softirq') + maxIf(p99,name='cpu_usage_irq') + maxIf(p99,name='cpu_usage_iowait'),0)) * 100 as "CPU non-idle %" FROM nyquist_live.samples WHERE name IN ('cpu_usage_idle','cpu_usage_user','cpu_usage_system','cpu_usage_softirq','cpu_usage_irq','cpu_usage_iowait') AND tags['cpu']='cpu' AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts

SELECT ts, 100*(1-sumIf(p50,name='memory_memavailable')/nullIf(sumIf(p50,name='memory_memtotal'),0)) as "Memory used %" FROM nyquist_live.samples WHERE name IN ('memory_memavailable','memory_memtotal') AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts

SELECT ts, maxIf(p99,name='cpu_usage_user') / nullIf(maxIf(p99,name='cpu_usage_idle') + maxIf(p99,name='cpu_usage_user') + maxIf(p99,name='cpu_usage_system') + maxIf(p99,name='cpu_usage_softirq') + maxIf(p99,name='cpu_usage_irq') + maxIf(p99,name='cpu_usage_iowait'),0) * 100 as "user" FROM nyquist_live.samples WHERE name IN ('cpu_usage_idle','cpu_usage_user','cpu_usage_system','cpu_usage_softirq','cpu_usage_irq','cpu_usage_iowait') AND tags['cpu']='cpu' AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts

SELECT ts, maxIf(p99,name='cpu_usage_system') / nullIf(maxIf(p99,name='cpu_usage_idle') + maxIf(p99,name='cpu_usage_user') + maxIf(p99,name='cpu_usage_system') + maxIf(p99,name='cpu_usage_softirq') + maxIf(p99,name='cpu_usage_irq') + maxIf(p99,name='cpu_usage_iowait'),0) * 100 as "system" FROM nyquist_live.samples WHERE name IN ('cpu_usage_idle','cpu_usage_user','cpu_usage_system','cpu_usage_softirq','cpu_usage_irq','cpu_usage_iowait') AND tags['cpu']='cpu' AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts

panels.title: Traffic share by queue — % of total RX packets/s (p99)

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts, tags['queue'] as queue, 100*p50/sum(p50) OVER (PARTITION BY ts) as share FROM nyquist_live.samples WHERE name='nic_queue_rx_packets' AND tags['iface']='${nic_iface}' AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND p50>0 ORDER BY ts

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts, maxIf(p50*8, name='network_transmit_bytes') AS "TX p50", maxIf(p90*8, name='network_transmit_bytes') AS "TX p90", maxIf(p99*8, name='network_transmit_bytes') AS "TX p99", maxIf(p999*8, name='network_transmit_bytes') AS "TX p999", maxIf(p50*8, name='network_receive_bytes') AS "RX p50", maxIf(p90*8, name='network_receive_bytes') AS "RX p90", maxIf(p99*8, name='network_receive_bytes') AS "RX p99", maxIf(p999*8, name='network_receive_bytes') AS "RX p999" FROM nyquist_live.samples WHERE name IN ('network_transmit_bytes','network_receive_bytes') AND tags['iface']='${nic_iface}' AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts
